title: 药房收购信用委员会备忘录
instruction:
您是 Genevieve Eberhardt，负责 Flintridge Clinic 收购合规审查的药剂师，Kwame Boateng 在 8 月星期三19、2026 将 Pinehollow 地区办事处药房业务的拟议收购提交给信贷委员会之前需要您的判断。 Flintridge 提议在 10 月 18 交割时以 $2.85 万收购卖方的处方文件、可销售库存、固定装置和租赁头寸，资金来源为所请求的 $2.25 万七年期贷款和 $600,000 买方股权。初步信用摘要将药房风险标记为“可接受”，因为卖方报告了调整后 EBITDA 的$620,000，并且该网站仍然盈利，但该标签是在药房审核之前输入的。您有权用您的评估和建议替换它。委员会主席菲奥娜·奥孔科沃 (Fiona Okonkwo) 希望 Kwame 可以将一页纸带入会议并进行辩护，而无需打开140页数据室或三年的索赔摘录。两名委员会成员了解药房报销和所有权转让；其他人则不然，因此备忘录必须使后果易于理解，但又不能成为药剂教程。截至 8 月15、2026，根据宾夕法尼亚州药房要求评估交易，并就贷款请求提出一项建议。
无论是有严格条件的批准还是对当前记录的延期都是可以辩护的，但不合格的批准则不然。以决定本身结束，而不是列出后续步骤。将建议锚定在一个对决策有用的数字中，并在该数字出现的任何地方保持一致。目前审核记录如下。 FY2024中的处方量为78,400，FY2025中为72,900，FY2026年度理赔运行中为64,800；这些时期的收入分别为$12.4 百万、$11.7 百万和$10.6 百万。卖方将下降归因于临时技术人员空缺，但索赔级别归因将13,600脚本从FY2024减少到FY2026，因为网站最大的推荐处方者群体搬迁后9,700处方丢失，2,100在付款人网络排除后丢失，以及1,800因一般流失而丢失。没有执行的推荐更换或记录的容量恢复计划。付款人A代表当前脚本的47%和总报销的52%；付款人B和C分别代表脚本的另外19%和13%以及总报销的16%和11%。每个脚本的总报销额从FY2024的$124.60下降到FY2026的$116.20，而每个脚本扣除成分成本、配药相关费用和已知的追溯优惠后的剩余金额从$12.40下降到$8.10。
付款人 A 已通知卖家 11 月的 1、2026 重置，如果当前组合保持不变，预计将在其脚本上减少另一个 $2.80 的剩余金额。单独的年终调节风险估计为$180,000 至$310,000。委员会成员通常以两种不同的方式使用“有效报销率”：一些是指每张处方的总报销额，另一些是指扣除购买成本、费用和优惠后剩余的金额。如果您使用该术语，请在得出结论之前明确其含义。卖方的 $620,000 调整后 EBITDA 包括所有者回加和承销未接受的假设。目前的贷方案例在付款人 A 重置之前为$355,000，在其估计影响后为$270,000，每年还本付息为$318,000。 Chidi Blackwood 还描述了采购和人员配置协同效应的$145,000，但没有执行供应商条款、人员配置时间表或其他支持将该金额纳入偿债能力。除了从这些数字得出的算术之外，请勿发明预测、估值、利率、回收百分比或缓解措施。合规审查还发现宾夕法尼亚州药房委员会公开同意令，指定卖方主管药剂师 Helena Kilgore，该命令于 2 月12、2025 至 2 月11、2027 生效。
它源于受控物质记录保存和库存核对失败，需要每季度进行受控物质审计、记录纠正措施并加强药剂师监督。该命令没有提到 Flintridge Clinic 或其拟议的主管药剂师的名字，但在拟议的关闭时该诊所仍将开放，目前的运营计划假设 Helena 将在过渡期间继续营业。没有人记录该命令如何影响这种依赖，其义务是否与海伦娜、现有许可证或两者有关，或者买方在操作前必须具备什么。房屋租赁期限为 9 月30、2030，基本租金为每月 $18,500。未经房东事先书面同意，禁止转让或转租，并且租户不享有单方面转让的权利。卖方报告称，房东表示支持，但没有签署同意书、修正案或更换租约。药房的许可地点、处方文件过渡、付款人参与和开业计划都假设不间断的占有，而所请求的贷款将在当前租赁期限之后保持未偿还状态。信用档案中没有最终所有权变更备案、买方药房许可证、付款人注册确认、管制物​​质库存协议或患者沟通计划。
将患者和处方者的身份保留在备忘录之外，并仅使用解释风险所需的最少敏感细节。清楚地区分既定事实、卖方或管理层的陈述、计算出的影响以及尚未解决的事项；并不意味着同意令、药房许可证、DEA 注册、付款人合同、租赁或处方关系仅仅因为购买资产而自动转移。使用该文件名将完成的一页贷方收购备忘录写入工作目录的顶层，即 `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf`。它必须独立于混合背景委员会，确定与初步药品风险标签相比发生的变化，提供由经济学和材料药品、监管、付款人和租赁问题支持的明确信用建议，并适合在一个可读的页面上。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf` — 由药剂师为贷方信用委员会准备的一页采购和合规评估。 （必须准确地使用所需的文件名写入工作目录的顶层。；必须包含一页可读的页面。；必须对贷款请求提出准确的一项建议并以该决定结束。；必须评估截至 8 月15、2026 的宾夕法尼亚州药房要求。；不得包含患者或处方者身份。；不得编造预测、估价、费率、恢复百分比或超出从所述算术得出的缓解措施数字。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: PDF 文字提取；可打开原文件查看排版。

criteria.description: 所需的 PDF 存在于提交的顶层，文件名为 `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf`。
criteria.evidence: 提交的文件路径和扩展名。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认准确的区分大小写的文件名和 PDF 扩展名。

original.criterion: The required PDF exists at the submitted top level under the exact filename `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf`.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the exact case-sensitive filename and PDF extension.

criteria.description: 提交的文件是有效的、可打开的 PDF，而不是重命名或损坏的文件。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开或渲染 PDF 并确认其文本和图形已加载。

original.criterion: The submitted file is a valid, openable PDF rather than a renamed or corrupt file.
original.grader_hint: Open or render the PDF and confirm that its text and graphics load.

criteria.description: 该备忘录仅包含一页。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查PDF页数；空白或接近空白的溢出页仍然有效。

original.criterion: The memo contains exactly one page.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the PDF page count; blank or near-blank overflow pages still count.

criteria.description: 所有实质性内容在页面边界内都是可见的，不会剪切、重叠文本或隐藏在可打印区域之外的内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 在正常缩放下检查完整渲染的页面，包括边距和底部决策线。

original.criterion: All substantive content is visible within the page boundaries without clipping, overlapping text, or content hidden outside the printable area.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the full rendered page at normal zoom, including margins and the bottom decision line.

criteria.description: 该页面作为委员会讲义仍然具有舒适的可读性，并且没有通过不切实际的小字体或极端压缩来达到限制。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的备忘录排版和密度。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断贷款人是否可以在不放大的情况下阅读打印的页面并快速找到核心决策。

original.criterion: The page remains comfortably readable as a committee handout and does not achieve the limit through impractically small type or extreme compression.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a lender could read the printed page without magnification and locate the core decision quickly.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将宾夕法尼亚州确定为管辖管辖区，并将 8 月15、2026 确定为评估日期或法定货币日期。
criteria.evidence: 日期线、范围说明书或等效文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受诸如“截至 8 月的宾夕法尼亚州要求15、2026”之类的措辞。

original.criterion: The memo identifies Pennsylvania as the governing jurisdiction and August 15, 2026 as the assessment date or legal currency date.
original.evidence: Dateline, scope statement, or equivalent text.
original.grader_hint: Accept wording such as “Pennsylvania requirements as of August 15, 2026.”

criteria.description: 该备忘录是为贷方或信贷委员会制定的，而不是卖方尽职报告、药房运营手册或法律意见书。
criteria.evidence: 贯穿始终的受众、框架和决策语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找信用相关性、还款能力、条件和交易可行性。

original.criterion: The memo is framed for a lender or credit committee rather than as a seller diligence report, pharmacy operations manual, or legal opinion.
original.evidence: Audience, framing, and decision language throughout.
original.grader_hint: Look for credit relevance, repayment capacity, conditions, and transaction viability.

criteria.description: 该备忘录针对贷款请求提出了一项最终建议。
criteria.grader_hint: 算最终调用，不支持条件。该页面不得提供替代方案或让批准与推迟悬而未决。

original.criterion: The memo makes exactly one ultimate recommendation on the loan request.
original.grader_hint: Count ultimate calls, not supporting conditions. The page must not offer alternatives or leave approve-versus-defer unresolved.

criteria.description: 该建议要么是有严格条件的批准，要么是在当前记录的基础上推迟，其选择的态度是经过深思熟虑且内部一致的。
criteria.grader_hint: 任何一种阅读都是可以接受的。不要授予不合格的批准或模棱两可的“考虑批准”表述。

original.criterion: The recommendation is either a tightly conditioned approval or a deferral on the current record, and its chosen posture is deliberate and internally coherent.
original.grader_hint: Either reading is acceptable. Do not award for an unqualified approval or an equivocal “consider approval” formulation.

criteria.description: 最后的实质性句子或决策线陈述了决策本身，而不是以后续步骤列表、提问邀请或未解决的警告结尾。
criteria.evidence: 页面上的最后一个实质性文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 忽略短页脚或保密标签；检查最后的实质性句子。

original.criterion: The final substantive sentence or decision line states the decision itself rather than ending with a next-steps list, an invitation for questions, or an unresolved caveat.
original.evidence: Last substantive text on the page.
original.grader_hint: Ignore a short footer or confidentiality label; inspect the final substantive sentence.

criteria.description: 该建议解决了有吸引力的整体盈利能力与较弱的标准化、压力、合规性和入住率证据之间的冲突。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不应将报告的 EBITDA 视为决定性的，也不应在未将风险与电话会议联系起来的情况下讨论风险。

original.criterion: The recommendation resolves the conflict between attractive headline profitability and the weaker normalized, stressed, compliance, and occupancy evidence.
original.grader_hint: The memo should not treat reported EBITDA as dispositive or discuss risks without connecting them to the call.

criteria.description: 该备忘录指出，初步的药房风险指定是“可接受的”，或者明确地识别了先前的指定。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受初步可接受分类的简明参考。

original.criterion: The memo states that the preliminary pharmacy-risk designation was “acceptable,” or unmistakably identifies that prior designation.
original.grader_hint: Accept a concise reference to the preliminary acceptable classification.

criteria.description: 该备忘录明确说明了药剂师采用的替代药房风险评估或分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 新的评估可能会被表述为有条件的、提高的、在当前记录中不可接受的，或者在明确的情况下推迟。

original.criterion: The memo expressly states the replacement pharmacy-risk assessment or classification adopted by the pharmacist.
original.grader_hint: The new assessment may be phrased as conditional, elevated, unacceptable on the current record, or defer, provided it is clear.

criteria.description: 该备忘录解释了为什么初步的“可接受”标签发生变化，而不仅仅是显示新标签。
criteria.evidence: 将更改后的评估与新考虑的事实联系起来的叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与标准化覆盖范围和材料付款人、数量、订单和租赁结果的简明联系。

original.criterion: The memo explains why the preliminary “acceptable” label changed rather than merely displaying a new label.
original.evidence: Narrative linking the changed assessment to newly considered facts.
original.grader_hint: Look for a concise connection to normalized coverage and the material payer, volume, order, and lease findings.

criteria.description: 单个对决策有用的数字锚点很突出，并且在逻辑上支持该建议。
criteria.evidence: 标题、摘要、经济学讨论或结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 预期的最强锚点受力 DSCR 约为 0.85x，但另一个正确导出且与决策相关的数字可能符合条件。

original.criterion: A single decision-useful numerical anchor is prominent and logically supports the recommendation.
original.evidence: Headline, summary, economics discussion, or conclusion.
original.grader_hint: The expected strongest anchor is stressed DSCR of approximately 0.85x, but another correctly derived and decision-relevant number may qualify.

criteria.description: 所选择的数字锚无论出现在哪里，都会得到一致的说明。
criteria.evidence: 备忘录中所有出现的锚点。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签、摘要文本、表格、标注和结论是否一致。

original.criterion: The chosen numerical anchor is stated consistently wherever it appears.
original.evidence: All occurrences of the anchor across the memo.
original.grader_hint: Check labels, summary text, tables, callouts, and conclusion for agreement.

criteria.description: 任何批准条件都是与已识别风险相关的真实决策条件，而不是通用的尽职调查愿望清单。
criteria.grader_hint: 条件应该足够具体，以便委员会能够了解在资助或运营之前必须解决什么问题。

original.criterion: Any approval conditions are true decision conditions tied to identified risks rather than a generic diligence wish list.
original.grader_hint: Conditions should be specific enough that committee can understand what must be resolved before funding or operation.

criteria.description: 该交易被正确地描述为涉及处方文件、可销售库存、固定装置和租赁位置的资产收购。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞可能会被压缩，但绝不能将该交易错误地描述为股权购买。

original.criterion: The transaction is correctly described as an asset acquisition involving prescription files, saleable inventory, fixtures, and the leasehold position.
original.grader_hint: The wording may be compressed, but it must not mischaracterize the deal as an equity purchase.

criteria.description: 购买价格为$2.85百万。

original.criterion: The purchase price is stated as $2.85 million.
original.grader_hint: Accept $2,850,000 or $2.85MM, with tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 请求的定期贷款为$2.25百万。

original.criterion: The requested term loan is stated as $2.25 million.
original.grader_hint: Accept $2,250,000 or $2.25MM, with tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 买方权益表示为$600,000。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用公差±$1。

original.criterion: Buyer equity is stated as $600,000.
original.grader_hint: Use tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 拟议的 10 月18、2026 截止日期已说明或明确用于评估未解决的预交割事项。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受完整的书面或数字日期，明确表示十月18，2026。

original.criterion: The proposed October 18, 2026 closing date is stated or clearly used in assessing the unresolved pre-closing matters.
original.grader_hint: Accept a fully written or numeric date that unambiguously means October 18, 2026.

criteria.description: 备忘录中规定的购买价格完全由规定的$2.25百万贷款加上$600,000股权资助。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证$2.25百万加上$600,000等于规定的$2.85百万购买价格。

original.criterion: The memo presents the stated purchase price as fully funded by the stated $2.25 million loan plus $600,000 equity.
original.grader_hint: Verify that $2.25 million plus $600,000 equals the stated $2.85 million purchase price.

criteria.description: 卖方报告的调整后 EBITDA 被准确标记并表述为 $620,000。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用公差 ±$1 并要求归因于卖家或报告的案例。

original.criterion: Seller-reported adjusted EBITDA is accurately labeled and stated as $620,000.
original.grader_hint: Use tolerance ±$1 and require attribution to the seller or reported case.

criteria.description: 付款人A重置之前的贷方案例记为$355,000。
criteria.evidence: 标准化收益或承保范围讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用公差±$1。

original.criterion: The lender case before the Payer A reset is stated as $355,000.
original.grader_hint: Use tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 估计付款人 A 影响后的贷方案例表示为$270,000。
criteria.evidence: 强调收益或承保范围的讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用公差±$1。

original.criterion: The lender case after the estimated Payer A effect is stated as $270,000.
original.grader_hint: Use tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 年度偿债记为$318,000。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用公差±$1。

original.criterion: Annual debt service is stated as $318,000.
original.grader_hint: Use tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 如果显示预重置偿债覆盖率，则等于$355,000除以$318,000，大约为1.12x。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受1.12x，公差为±0.01x。如果备忘录完全忽略了这个指标，则不要奖励。

original.criterion: If pre-reset debt-service coverage is shown, it equals $355,000 divided by $318,000, approximately 1.12x.
original.grader_hint: Accept 1.12x with tolerance ±0.01x. If the memo omits this metric entirely, do not award.

criteria.description: 压力偿债覆盖率等于$270,000除以$318,000，大约为0.85x。
criteria.evidence: 覆盖率计算和决策理由。

original.criterion: Stressed debt-service coverage equals $270,000 divided by $318,000, approximately 0.85x.
original.grader_hint: Accept 0.85x with tolerance ±0.01x.

criteria.description: 该备忘录正确地将低于 1.00x 的压力覆盖率解释为建模现金流不足以支付年度偿债。
criteria.evidence: 与覆盖率指标相邻的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的还款能力结果，而不仅仅是数字。

original.criterion: The memo correctly interprets stressed coverage below 1.00x as insufficient modeled cash flow to cover annual debt service.
original.evidence: Interpretation adjacent to the coverage metric.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit repayment-capacity consequence, not merely the number.

criteria.description: 拟议的采购和人员配置协同效应的$145,000被确定为不受支持或被排除在可靠的偿债能力之外。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录可以简要提及金额，但不得依赖其作为已实现的现金流量。

original.criterion: The $145,000 of proposed purchasing and staffing synergies is identified as unsupported or excluded from reliable debt-service capacity.
original.grader_hint: The memo may mention the amount briefly but must not rely on it as realized cash flow.

criteria.description: 该备忘录不会使用不受支持的协同效应金额来筹集压力现金流或 DSCR。
criteria.evidence: 所有收入和承保范围计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算任何显示的受压案例并确认未添加$145,000。

original.criterion: The memo does not use the unsupported synergy amount to raise stressed cash flow or DSCR.
original.grader_hint: Recalculate any displayed stressed case and confirm that $145,000 was not added.

criteria.description: 处方量系列准确地表示为FY2024中的78,400、FY2025中的72,900以及FY2026年化中的64,800。
criteria.evidence: 成交量趋势文本、表格或图形。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个值以及FY2026的年化状态都必须正确。

original.criterion: The prescription-volume series is accurately stated as 78,400 in FY2024, 72,900 in FY2025, and 64,800 in FY2026 annualized.
original.evidence: Volume trend text, table, or graphic.
original.grader_hint: All three values and the annualized status of FY2026 must be correct.

criteria.description: FY2024-to-FY2026 处方下降被正确量化为 13,600 脚本。

original.criterion: The FY2024-to-FY2026 prescription decline is correctly quantified as 13,600 scripts.
original.grader_hint: Verify 78,400 minus 64,800; tolerance ±1 script.

criteria.description: 如果总的FY2024-to-FY2026处方下降率以百分比表示，则大约为17.3%。

original.criterion: If the total FY2024-to-FY2026 prescription decline is expressed as a percentage, it is approximately 17.3%.
original.grader_hint: Accept 17.3% or 17.35%, tolerance ±0.2 percentage points.

criteria.description: 该收入系列准确表述为年化FY2024、FY2025 和FY2026 分别为$12.4 百万、$11.7 百万和$10.6 百万。
criteria.evidence: 收入趋势文本、表格或图形。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要正确的期间关联并认识到FY2026是年化的。

original.criterion: The revenue series is accurately stated as $12.4 million, $11.7 million, and $10.6 million for FY2024, FY2025, and FY2026 annualized, respectively.
original.evidence: Revenue trend text, table, or graphic.
original.grader_hint: Require correct period association and recognition that FY2026 is annualized.

criteria.description: 如果FY2024-to-FY2026收入下降以百分比表示，则约为14.5%。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受公差±0.2个百分点。

original.criterion: If the FY2024-to-FY2026 revenue decline is expressed as a percentage, it is approximately 14.5%.
original.grader_hint: Accept tolerance ±0.2 percentage points.

criteria.description: 卖方对临时技术人员空缺的解释被明确标记为卖方代表，而不是既定原因。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找诸如“卖家属性”、“管理层说”或类似内容的归因。

original.criterion: The seller’s explanation of temporary technician vacancies is clearly labeled as a seller representation rather than an established cause.
original.grader_hint: Look for attribution such as “seller attributes,” “management says,” or equivalent.

criteria.description: 该备忘录准确地将13,600脚本拒绝归因于处方者群体搬迁的9,700处方、付款人网络排除的2,100以及一般流失的1,800。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有三个原因和值都必须正确；验证它们的总和是否为13,600。

original.criterion: The memo accurately attributes the 13,600-script decline to 9,700 prescriptions from the prescriber-group relocation, 2,100 from payer network exclusion, and 1,800 from general attrition.
original.grader_hint: All three causes and values must be correct; verify that they sum to 13,600.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，处方组重新安置约占总处方下降的71.3%。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受诸如“大约71%”之类的陈述，误差为±1百分点。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that the prescriber-group relocation accounts for approximately 71.3% of the total script decline.
original.grader_hint: Accept a statement such as “about 71%” with tolerance ±1 percentage point.

criteria.description: 数量下降的特点是结构性的，而不是临时人员的充分解释。
criteria.evidence: 对搬迁、网络丢失和消耗的解释。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录应优先考虑有证据的原因，而不是卖方不受支持的临时解释。

original.criterion: The volume decline is characterized as substantially structural rather than adequately explained by temporary staffing.
original.evidence: Interpretation of relocation, network loss, and attrition.
original.grader_hint: The memo should prioritize evidenced causes over the seller’s unsupported temporary explanation.

criteria.description: 缺乏执行的推荐更换或记录的恢复计划被认为限制了对销量反弹的依赖。
criteria.evidence: 成交量展望或承保警告。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受不支持恢复假设的等效语言。

original.criterion: The absence of an executed referral replacement or documented recovery plan is identified as limiting reliance on a volume rebound.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent language that no recovery assumption is supported.

criteria.description: 付款人 A 被准确识别为当前脚本的47% 和总报销额的52%。
criteria.grader_hint: 百分比及其不同的分母都必须清楚。

original.criterion: Payer A is accurately identified as 47% of current scripts and 52% of gross reimbursement.
original.grader_hint: Both percentages and their different denominators must be clear.

criteria.description: 前三名支付者集中度准确地表示为脚本的79%。

original.criterion: The top-three payer concentration is accurately presented as 79% of scripts.
original.grader_hint: Verify 47% + 19% + 13% = 79%, tolerance ±0.1 percentage point.

criteria.description: 前三名付款人集中度准确地表示为报销总额的79%。

original.criterion: The top-three payer concentration is accurately presented as 79% of gross reimbursement.
original.grader_hint: Verify 52% + 16% + 11% = 79%, tolerance ±0.1 percentage point.

criteria.description: 该备忘录解释了为什么付款人集中会创造收益和续约或网络曝光，而不仅仅是上市股票。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对少数付款人决策的依赖以及对付款人 A 的不成比例的风险。

original.criterion: The memo explains why payer concentration creates earnings and renewal or network exposure rather than merely listing shares.
original.grader_hint: Look for dependence on a small number of payer decisions and disproportionate exposure to Payer A.

criteria.description: 每个脚本的总报销准确显示为从FY2024中的$124.60下降到FY2026中的$116.20。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要正确的标签和时期关联。

original.criterion: Gross reimbursement per script is accurately shown as falling from $124.60 in FY2024 to $116.20 in FY2026.
original.grader_hint: Require correct labels and period association.

criteria.description: 如果量化的话，每个脚本的总报销下降约为6.7%。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受公差±0.2个百分点。

original.criterion: If quantified, the decline in gross reimbursement per script is approximately 6.7%.
original.grader_hint: Accept tolerance ±0.2 percentage points.

criteria.description: 扣除成分成本、配药相关费用和已知优惠后，每个脚本的剩余金额准确显示为从$12.40下降到$8.10。
criteria.evidence: 网络经济学或传播讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不得将这些金额标记为总报销额。

original.criterion: The amount remaining per script after ingredient cost, dispensing-related fees, and known concessions is accurately shown as falling from $12.40 to $8.10.
original.grader_hint: The memo must not label these amounts as gross reimbursement.

criteria.description: 如果量化的话，每个脚本的剩余量从$12.40到$8.10大约下降了34.7%。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受公差±0.3个百分点。

original.criterion: If quantified, the decline in the amount remaining per script from $12.40 to $8.10 is approximately 34.7%.
original.grader_hint: Accept tolerance ±0.3 percentage points.

criteria.description: 在使用“有效报销率”一词之前，备忘录定义了它是指每张处方的总报销额还是事后成本、事后费用、事后优惠金额。
criteria.evidence: 该术语的定义和后续使用。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果未使用该短语，则仅当备忘录一致使用明确的标签并且从不混淆措施时才授予奖励。

original.criterion: Before relying on the phrase “effective reimbursement rate,” the memo defines whether it means gross reimbursement per prescription or the post-cost, post-fee, post-concession amount.
original.evidence: Definition and subsequent use of the term.
original.grader_hint: If the phrase is not used, award only if the memo instead uses unambiguous labels consistently and never conflates the measures.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将总报销额与药房利润或剩余分摊额区分开来。
criteria.grader_hint: 查看所有按脚本货币计算的参考文献，了解分母和经济意义。

original.criterion: The memo keeps gross reimbursement distinct from pharmacy margin or remaining spread throughout.
original.grader_hint: Review all monetary-per-script references for denominator and economic meaning.

criteria.description: 付款人 A 重置被准确地描述为付款人 A 脚本上剩余金额的 $2.80 减少，如果当前组合保持不变，则于 11 月 1、2026 生效。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求数量、受影响人群、生效日期和条件组合基础。

original.criterion: The Payer A reset is accurately described as a $2.80 reduction in the remaining amount on Payer A scripts, effective November 1, 2026, if current mix holds.
original.grader_hint: Require the amount, affected population, effective date, and conditional mix basis.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，11 月 1 付款人 A 重置发生在拟议的 10 月 18 关闭后不久。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找重置被视为接近收盘后暴露。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that the November 1 Payer A reset occurs shortly after the proposed October 18 closing.
original.grader_hint: Look for the reset being treated as near-immediate post-closing exposure.

criteria.description: 如果根据当前脚本组合计算付款人 A 重置的年化直接影响，则约为$85,300。

original.criterion: If the annualized direct effect of the Payer A reset is calculated from current script mix, it is approximately $85,300.

criteria.description: 单独的年终调节风险被准确表述为$180,000至$310,000的范围，并且不会默默地折叠为单个特定金额。
criteria.grader_hint: 两个端点必须正确，公差±$1。

original.criterion: The separate year-end reconciliation exposure is accurately stated as a range of $180,000 to $310,000 and is not silently collapsed into a single certain amount.
original.grader_hint: Both endpoints must be correct, tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 付款人 A 重置和年末调节风险被视为不同的风险，除非备忘录明确解释了它们之间的任何关系。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不应重复计算或暗示一个数字必然包括另一个数字而没有支持。

original.criterion: The Payer A reset and year-end reconciliation exposure are treated as distinct exposures unless the memo explicitly explains any relationship between them.
original.grader_hint: The memo should not double count or imply that one figure necessarily includes the other without support.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，买方的付款人注册或网络参与需要确认，并且不应从资产购买中假设。
criteria.evidence: 付款人转换风险或批准条件。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找买家注册、认证、签约或网络连续性作为未解决的交易依赖项。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that payer enrollment or network participation for the buyer requires confirmation and should not be assumed from the asset purchase.
original.grader_hint: Look for buyer enrollment, credentialing, contracting, or network continuity as an unresolved transaction dependency.

criteria.description: 公开同意令被准确识别为宾夕法尼亚州药房委员会命令，于 2 月12、2025 至 2 月11、2027 生效。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要正确的权限和日期。

original.criterion: The open consent order is accurately identified as a Pennsylvania State Board of Pharmacy order effective February 12, 2025 through February 11, 2027.
original.grader_hint: Require correct authority and dates.

criteria.description: 该备忘录准确地确定了受控物质记录保存和库存核对失败，作为同意令的基础。
criteria.grader_hint: 记录保存和库存核对均应予以体现。

original.criterion: The memo accurately identifies controlled-substance recordkeeping and inventory-reconciliation failures as the basis of the consent order.
original.grader_hint: Both recordkeeping and inventory reconciliation should be represented.

criteria.description: 同意令义务被准确地总结为季度受控物质审核、记录的纠正措施和加强药剂师监督。
criteria.grader_hint: 尽管措辞可能简洁，但所有三项义务均应出现。

original.criterion: The consent-order obligations are accurately summarized as quarterly controlled-substance audits, documented corrective action, and enhanced pharmacist supervision.
original.grader_hint: All three obligations should appear, though wording may be concise.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认同意令将在拟议的 10 月 18、2026 截止日期保持有效。
criteria.grader_hint: 该订单于二月11、2027 结束，因此在收盘时处于活动状态。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that the consent order will remain open on the proposed October 18, 2026 closing date.
original.grader_hint: The order ends February 11, 2027, so it is active at closing.

criteria.description: Helena Kilgore 被正确识别为卖方的主管药剂师和订单中指定的人员。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录不得将她确定为弗林特里奇拟议的主管药剂师。

original.criterion: Helena Kilgore is correctly identified as the seller’s pharmacist-in-charge and the person named in the order.
original.grader_hint: The memo must not identify her as Flintridge’s proposed pharmacist-in-charge.

criteria.description: 该备忘录并不意味着同意令仅仅因为 Flintridge Clinic 购买资产而自动成为其责任。
criteria.evidence: 该命令的法律和操作效力的特征。
criteria.grader_hint: 仔细区分指定方责任和未解决的运营或许可影响。

original.criterion: The memo does not imply that the consent order automatically becomes Flintridge Clinic’s liability merely because it buys assets.
original.evidence: Characterization of the order’s legal and operational effect.
original.grader_hint: Credit careful distinction between named-party liability and unresolved operational or permit implications.

criteria.description: 该备忘录解释说，即使订单中没有指定买方，在过渡期间继续依赖所订购的主管药剂师也会产生运营和监督风险。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对人员连续性、监督、审计负担或开业准备情况的影响。

original.criterion: The memo explains that continued reliance on the ordered pharmacist-in-charge during transition creates an operational and supervisory risk even if the buyer is not named in the order.
original.grader_hint: Look for implications for staffing continuity, supervision, audit burden, or opening readiness.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将向药剂师申请的订单确认、许可证和过渡计划视为未解决的问题，需要权威解决，而不是提供不受支持的法律确定性。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受需要董事会、顾问或监管机构书面确认的简明条件。

original.criterion: The memo treats confirmation of the order’s application to the pharmacist, permit, and transition plan as an unresolved matter requiring authoritative resolution rather than offering unsupported legal certainty.
original.grader_hint: Accept a concise condition requiring Board, counsel, or documented regulatory confirmation.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，买方必须根据买方经营的需要指定一名合格的主管药剂师并获得其接受或批准，而不是假设卖方的指定继续有效。
criteria.grader_hint: 无需背诵准确的归档术语，但非自动 PIC 转换必须清晰。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that the buyer must designate and obtain acceptance or approval of an eligible pharmacist-in-charge as required for the buyer’s operation, rather than assuming the seller’s designation carries over.
original.grader_hint: Exact filing terminology need not be recited, but the nonautomatic PIC transition must be clear.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，买方在经营前必须获得药房许可证或所有权授权，并且不会随资产自动转让。
criteria.grader_hint: 无需提供程序备案说明即可获得准确的所有权变更或新许可证处理。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that a pharmacy permit or ownership authorization must be in place for the buyer before operation and is not automatically transferred with the assets.
original.grader_hint: Credit accurate ownership-change or new-permit treatment without requiring procedural filing instructions.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认 DEA 注册是特定于地点和注册人的，不应被描述为可自动转让给买方。
criteria.grader_hint: 在进行管制物质操作之前，请先查找买方注册或授权依赖性。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that a DEA registration is location- and registrant-specific and should not be described as automatically transferable to the buyer.
original.grader_hint: Look for a buyer registration or authorization dependency before controlled-substance operations.

criteria.description: 该备忘录确定了对受控物质进行记录的期末库存和合法转移处理的必要性。
criteria.evidence: 受控物质过渡风险或状况。
criteria.grader_hint: 简要参考见证/记录的库存和适合时间表的转移记录就足够了。

original.criterion: The memo identifies the need for a documented closing inventory and lawful transfer treatment for controlled substances.
original.grader_hint: A concise reference to witnessed/documented inventory and schedule-appropriate transfer records is sufficient.

criteria.description: 该租约被准确描述为持续到 9 月30、2030，基本租金为每月 $18,500。
criteria.grader_hint: 要求正确的日期和每月金额，公差±$1。

original.criterion: The lease is accurately described as running through September 30, 2030 at base rent of $18,500 per month.
original.grader_hint: Require correct date and monthly amount, tolerance ±$1.

criteria.description: 备忘录指出，转让或转租需要房东事先书面同意，租户没有单方面转让权。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须传达书面同意要求和缺乏单方面权利。

original.criterion: The memo states that assignment or subletting requires the landlord’s prior written consent and that the tenant has no unilateral assignment right.
original.grader_hint: Both the written-consent requirement and absence of a unilateral right must be conveyed.

criteria.description: 卖方关于房东支持的报告被标记为未经证实的陈述，不被视为同意。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找口头或报告的支持与执行的文档之间的区别。

original.criterion: The seller’s report that the landlord is supportive is labeled as an unverified representation and not treated as consent.
original.grader_hint: Look for a distinction between verbal or reported support and executed documentation.

criteria.description: 发现没有签署房东同意书、租约修改或更换租约。
criteria.grader_hint: 备忘录可以压缩这些替代方案，但必须明确表明不存在可用于转让的有效占用文件。

original.criterion: The absence of a signed landlord consent, lease amendment, or replacement lease is identified.
original.grader_hint: The memo may compress these alternatives but must make clear that no operative occupancy document exists for the transfer.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将租赁控制与许可地点、开放能力、处方文件过渡或付款人参与联系起来，而不是将其视为普通的房地产脚注。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找至少一种药房特定的后果以及占用率对交易至关重要的解释。

original.criterion: The memo connects lease control to the licensed location, ability to open, prescription-file transition, or payer participation rather than treating it as an ordinary real-estate footnote.
original.grader_hint: Look for at least one pharmacy-specific consequence and an explanation that occupancy is transaction-critical.

criteria.description: 如果建议是有条件批准，则房东的书面同意或已执行的更换租约将被视为交割前或预融资要求；如果这是选定的决定，则被视为推迟的理由。
criteria.grader_hint: 租赁缺陷必须影响决策，而不仅仅是出现在风险列表中。

original.criterion: Written landlord consent or an executed replacement lease is treated as a pre-closing or pre-funding requirement if the recommendation is conditional approval, or as a reason for deferral if that is the selected decision.
original.grader_hint: The lease defect must affect the decision, not merely appear in a risk list.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，七年期贷款将延续到2030当前的租约到期之后。
criteria.evidence: 租赁期限和贷款期限分析。
criteria.grader_hint: 不需要精确的到期日期，但期限不匹配必须明确。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that the seven-year loan would extend beyond the current lease expiration in 2030.
original.grader_hint: No precise maturity date is required, but the duration mismatch must be explicit.

criteria.description: 该备忘录将患者的选择和适当的患者沟通视为处方文件转换的一部分，而不是将处方关系视为拥有的客户资产。
criteria.evidence: 处方文件或患者过渡讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求选择药房的自由、转移通知、访问的连续性或同等的以患者为中心的治疗。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes patient choice and appropriate patient communication as part of a prescription-file transition rather than treating prescription relationships as owned customer assets.
original.grader_hint: Look for freedom to choose a pharmacy, transfer notice, continuity of access, or equivalent patient-centered treatment.

criteria.description: 该备忘录承认，处方记录和患者信息在尽职调查和转移过程中需要合法、最低限度的必要处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 简洁的 HIPAA/隐私声明就足够了；备忘录不必成为隐私教程。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that prescription records and patient information require lawful, minimum-necessary handling during diligence and transfer.
original.grader_hint: A concise HIPAA/privacy statement is sufficient; the memo need not become a privacy tutorial.

criteria.description: 备忘录中没有出现患者或处方者的身份。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查名称、示例、脚注以及任何屏幕截图或嵌入数据。

original.criterion: No patient or prescriber identity appears in the memo.
original.grader_hint: Inspect names, examples, footnotes, and any screenshots or embedded data.

criteria.description: 该备忘录认识到，处方和管制药物记录必须在所有权过渡期间根据需要保持可访问和保留。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受有关记录保管、连续性或保留的简明声明；不需要详细的保留期限。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that prescription and controlled-substance records must remain accessible and retained as required through the ownership transition.
original.grader_hint: Accept a concise statement about record custody, continuity, or retention; detailed retention periods are not required.

criteria.description: 该备忘录认识到，库存价值和可转让性取决于排除或正确处理过期、召回、损坏、不可销售和退回供应商的库存。
criteria.grader_hint: 措辞可能会被压缩，但它必须表明药剂师对什么构成可销售库存的判断。

original.criterion: The memo recognizes that inventory value and transferability depend on excluding or properly handling expired, recalled, damaged, unsaleable, and return-to-vendor stock.
original.grader_hint: The wording may be compressed, but it must show pharmacist judgment about what constitutes saleable inventory.

criteria.description: 该备忘录通过清晰的标签或明确无误的散文将既定的评论事实、卖方或管理层的陈述、计算出的影响以及未解决的问题分开。
criteria.evidence: 整个备忘录中的标签和语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 测试示例包括临时人员配置、房东支持、协同效应、DSCR 和监管适用性。

original.criterion: The memo separates established review facts, seller or management representations, calculated implications, and unresolved matters through clear labeling or unmistakable prose.
original.evidence: Labels and language across the full memo.
original.grader_hint: Test examples including temporary staffing, landlord support, synergies, DSCR, and regulatory applicability.

criteria.description: 该备忘录没有介绍不受支持的预测、估值、利率、回收百分比或超出从所述数据得出的算术的缓解措施。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用简短的数字将每个定量主张追溯到简短或透明的算术。

original.criterion: The memo does not introduce unsupported forecasts, valuations, rates, recovery percentages, or mitigants beyond arithmetic derived from the stated figures.
original.grader_hint: Trace each quantitative claim to the brief or transparent arithmetic using brief figures.

criteria.description: 法律和监管声明经过适当限定，不会将一页药剂师备忘录作为明确的法律意见。
criteria.evidence: 法律主张的语气和确定性。
criteria.grader_hint: 信用特定的、实用的陈述，区分已知的不可转让性和未解决的应用问题。

original.criterion: Legal and regulatory statements are appropriately qualified and do not present the one-page pharmacist memo as a definitive legal opinion.
original.evidence: Tone and certainty of legal assertions.
original.grader_hint: Credit specific, practical statements that distinguish known nontransferability and unresolved application questions.

criteria.description: 该备忘录为非药房委员会成员提供了足够的背景信息，让他们了解报销范围、付款人集中度、同意令和租赁依赖性，而无需冗长的指导材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断不熟悉的读者是否能够在页面仍然充当备忘录的情况下理解决策后果。

original.criterion: The memo gives non-pharmacy committee members enough context to understand reimbursement spread, payer concentration, the consent order, and the lease dependency without lengthy instructional material.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether unfamiliar readers can understand decision consequences while the page still functions as a memo.

criteria.description: 该备忘录保留了足够的药房特定精度，供知识渊博的委员会成员区分总报销、剩余差额、许可或注册问题以及付款人登记。
criteria.grader_hint: 诸如“存在监管风险”之类的笼统陈述是不够的。

original.criterion: The memo retains enough pharmacy-specific precision for knowledgeable committee members to distinguish gross reimbursement, remaining spread, permit or registration issues, and payer enrollment.
original.grader_hint: Generic statements such as “regulatory risks exist” are insufficient.

criteria.description: 四个不成比例的重大问题——付款人集中度和利率风险、结构性下降的脚本、公开同意令和不可转让的租赁——都足够突出，足以影响读者的决定。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断突出性和决策联系，而不是每个问题是否得到平等的空间。

original.criterion: The four disproportionately material issues—payer concentration and rate exposure, structurally declining scripts, the open consent order, and the nonassignable lease—are all prominent enough to affect the reader’s decision.
original.grader_hint: Judge prominence and decision connection, not whether each issue receives equal space.

criteria.description: 数字带有明确的单位、期间和标签，因此脚本、收入、每个脚本的金额、年度现金流和百分比不会混淆。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查紧凑的表格、标注和散文是否有缺失的单元或模糊的句点标签。

original.criterion: Numbers carry clear units, periods, and labels so that scripts, revenue, per-script amounts, annual cash flow, and percentages cannot be confused.
original.grader_hint: Inspect compact tables, callouts, and prose for missing units or ambiguous period labels.

criteria.description: 总体而言，该备忘录是一份值得信赖的单页委员会文书：简洁、内容完整、明确，信贷员无需要求作者澄清即可使用。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查详细项目后，进行整体的专业判断；技术上正确的片段不支持可辩护的决定，不应获得此荣誉。

original.criterion: Taken as a whole, the memo is a defensible one-page committee instrument: concise, materially complete, unambiguous, and usable by the loan officer without asking the author for clarification.
original.grader_hint: Apply holistic professional judgment after checking the detailed items; technically correct fragments that do not support a defendable decision should not receive this credit.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

spec.professional_context: A pharmacist is providing the final pharmacy-compliance and operating-risk assessment for a lender considering financing an asset acquisition. The memo must support a near-term credit decision while accurately translating pharmacy-specific exposure for a mixed-background committee.
difficulty_sources: A one-page limit forces disproportionate emphasis on four risks that would be buried by proportional summarization.
The reported profitability and preliminary acceptable-risk label conflict with normalized and stressed repayment capacity.
The audience mixes pharmacy-literate and non-pharmacy credit stakeholders.
A routinely used reimbursement term has two materially different meanings.
The open consent order creates a distinction between named-party liability and practical transition exposure.
The lease, licensing, payer, controlled-substance, privacy, and patient-transition issues interact at the proposed closing.
Two decision postures are defensible, but the practitioner must choose and support only one.

authoring_plan.solver_instance: A retail-pharmacy compliance pharmacist translating acquisition diligence into a one-page lender decision memo.
authoring_plan.intended_verdict: An unconditional approval is not supported. The gold may either defer the request on the current record or approve only subject to decision-critical pre-funding and pre-operation conditions. It must select one posture, not present both.

planted_tension.headline_case: Reported adjusted EBITDA appears adequate and created a preliminary acceptable-risk label.
planted_tension.controlling_evidence: Normalized earnings provide only thin pre-reset coverage, the supported stressed case falls below debt service, most script loss is structural, payer exposure is concentrated, the order remains open at closing, and occupancy is not assignable without written landlord action.
planted_tension.acceptable_resolution_A: Conditioned approval, with enforceable conditions addressing occupancy, pharmacy ownership authorization, pharmacist-in-charge readiness, controlled-substance authority and inventory, payer continuity, order implications, and repayment capacity.
planted_tension.acceptable_resolution_B: Deferral on the current record until those same matters are resolved and a supportable coverage case exists.

gold_relationships: Transaction sources equal the purchase price: requested debt plus buyer equity equals total consideration.
Total script decline equals FY2024 scripts minus FY2026 annualized scripts.
The three attributed causes sum exactly to the total script decline.
The relocation cause divided by total decline is approximately 71.3%, supporting a structural rather than temporary interpretation.
Top-three script concentration equals the sum of the three stated script shares.
Top-three gross-reimbursement concentration equals the sum of the three stated reimbursement shares.
Pre-reset DSCR equals lender-case cash flow divided by annual debt service.
Stressed DSCR equals post-reset lender-case cash flow divided by annual debt service and is below 1.00x.
The estimated annual Payer A reset effect may be derived by multiplying annualized scripts by Payer A’s script share and the per-script reduction.
The consent order remains active at the proposed closing because its end date follows closing.
The seven-year loan extends beyond the stated lease expiration.
The Payer A reset follows shortly after the proposed closing.
professional_rules_expected: Distinguish an asset acquisition from automatic transfer of permits, registrations, payer participation, prescription relationships, and lease rights.
Treat buyer pharmacy authorization and an eligible pharmacist-in-charge as operational prerequisites rather than post-closing cleanup.
Treat DEA authority as registrant- and location-specific and require lawful controlled-substance inventory and transfer documentation.
Separate the named pharmacist’s consent-order exposure from the buyer’s legal status while recognizing transition, supervision, and permit implications.
Treat written occupancy control as essential to operation of a location-licensed pharmacy.
Recognize payer enrollment and network continuity as transaction dependencies.
Protect patient choice, privacy, continuity, and record custody during prescription-file transfer.
Limit inventory value to stock that is lawfully transferable and saleable.
Exclude unsupported synergies and unsupported recovery assumptions from reliable debt-service capacity.
Use evidence labels that distinguish verified facts, representations, calculations, and unresolved matters.

terminology_control.required_handling: The gold must either define the term before use or avoid it in favor of consistently unambiguous labels.
distinct_measures: Amount remaining per prescription after ingredient cost, dispensing-related fees, and known retrospective concessions.

authoring_plan.audience_test: A lender without pharmacy background must understand the credit consequences, while a pharmacy-literate reviewer must still find the distinctions technically accurate. The memo should not become a tutorial.
authoring_plan.privacy_test: No patient or prescriber identity should appear. Sensitive regulatory detail should be limited to what is necessary to explain transaction and operating risk.
authoring_plan.completion_test: The final substantive line must be the selected loan decision. The same numerical decision anchor must agree everywhere it appears, and all four material issues must visibly influence the recommendation.

deliverables.description: One-page pharmacist-prepared acquisition and compliance assessment for the lender’s credit committee.
constraints: Must be written to the top level of the working directory using exactly the required filename.
Must contain exactly one readable page.
Must make exactly one recommendation on the loan request and end on that decision.
Must assess Pennsylvania pharmacy requirements as of August 15, 2026.
Must not contain patient or prescriber identities.
Must not invent forecasts, valuations, rates, recovery percentages, or mitigants beyond arithmetic derived from the stated figures.

original_instruction:
You’re Genevieve Eberhardt, the pharmacist leading acquisition compliance review for Flintridge Clinic, and Kwame Boateng needs your judgment before he takes the proposed purchase of the Pinehollow Regional Office pharmacy operation to credit committee on Wednesday, August 19, 2026. Flintridge proposes to acquire the seller’s prescription files, saleable inventory, fixtures, and leasehold position at an October 18 closing for $2.85 million, funded with a requested $2.25 million seven-year term loan and $600,000 of buyer equity. The preliminary credit summary labels pharmacy risk “acceptable” because the seller reported $620,000 of adjusted EBITDA and the site remains profitable, but that label was entered before pharmacy review. You are authorized to replace it with your assessment and recommendation. Fiona Okonkwo, who chairs committee, wants a single page that Kwame can carry into the meeting and defend without opening the 140-page data room or three years of claims extracts. Two committee members understand pharmacy reimbursement and ownership transitions; the others do not, so the memo has to make the consequences intelligible without becoming a pharmacy tutorial. Assess the transaction under Pennsylvania pharmacy requirements as of August 15, 2026 and make exactly one recommendation on the loan request. Either a tightly conditioned approval or a deferral on the current record can be defensible, but an unqualified approval is not. End with the decision itself, not a list of next steps. Anchor the recommendation in one decision-useful number and keep that number consistent wherever it appears. The current review record is as follows. Prescription volume was 78,400 in FY2024, 72,900 in FY2025, and 64,800 in the FY2026 annualized claims run; revenue for those periods was $12.4 million, $11.7 million, and $10.6 million. The seller attributes the decline to temporary technician vacancies, but the claim-level attribution accounts for the 13,600-script reduction from FY2024 to FY2026 as 9,700 prescriptions lost after the site’s largest referring prescriber group relocated, 2,100 lost after a payer network exclusion, and 1,800 from general attrition. There is no executed referral replacement or documented volume-recovery plan. Payer A represents 47% of current scripts and 52% of gross reimbursement; Payers B and C represent another 19% and 13% of scripts and 16% and 11% of gross reimbursement, respectively. Gross reimbursement per script fell from $124.60 in FY2024 to $116.20 in FY2026, while the amount remaining per script after ingredient cost, dispensing-related fees, and known retrospective concessions fell from $12.40 to $8.10. Payer A has notified the seller of a November 1, 2026 reset expected to reduce that remaining amount by another $2.80 on its scripts if the current mix holds. A separate year-end reconciliation exposure is estimated at $180,000 to $310,000. People in committee routinely use “effective reimbursement rate” in two different ways: some mean gross reimbursement per prescription, while others mean the amount remaining after acquisition cost, fees, and concessions. If you use that term, make its meaning unambiguous before drawing a conclusion from it. The seller’s $620,000 adjusted EBITDA includes owner add-backs and assumptions that underwriting has not accepted. The current lender case is $355,000 before the Payer A reset and $270,000 after its estimated effect, against annual debt service of $318,000. Chidi Blackwood has also described $145,000 of purchasing and staffing synergies, but there are no executed vendor terms, staffing schedules, or other support for including that amount in debt-service capacity. Do not invent forecasts, valuations, rates, recovery percentages, or mitigants beyond arithmetic derived from these figures. The compliance review also found an open Pennsylvania State Board of Pharmacy consent order naming Helena Kilgore, the seller’s pharmacist-in-charge, effective February 12, 2025 through February 11, 2027. It arose from controlled-substance recordkeeping and inventory-reconciliation failures and requires quarterly controlled-substance audits, documented corrective action, and enhanced pharmacist supervision. The order does not name Flintridge Clinic or its proposed pharmacist-in-charge, but it will still be open at the proposed closing, and the operating plan currently assumes Helena will remain through transition. No one has documented how the order affects that reliance, whether its obligations attach to Helena, the existing permit, or both, or what the buyer must have in place before operating. The premises lease runs through September 30, 2030 at base rent of $18,500 per month. It prohibits assignment or subletting without the landlord’s prior written consent and gives the tenant no unilateral assignment right. The seller reports that the landlord is supportive, but there is no signed consent, amendment, or replacement lease. The pharmacy’s licensed location, prescription-file transition, payer participation, and opening plan all assume uninterrupted possession, while the requested loan would remain outstanding beyond the current lease term. No final ownership-change filing, buyer pharmacy permit, payer enrollment confirmation, controlled-substance inventory protocol, or patient communication plan is in the credit file. Keep patient and prescriber identities out of the memo and use only the minimum sensitive detail needed to explain the risks. Clearly distinguish established facts, seller or management representations, calculated implications, and matters that remain unresolved; do not imply that a consent order, pharmacy permit, DEA registration, payer contract, lease, or prescription relationship automatically transfers merely because assets are being purchased. Write the finished one-page lender acquisition memo as `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf` at the top level of the working directory using exactly that filename. It must stand on its own for the mixed-background committee, identify what changed from the preliminary pharmacy-risk label, give one clear credit recommendation supported by the economics and the material pharmacy, regulatory, payer, and lease issues, and fit on one readable page.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `pinehollow_acquisition_memo.pdf` — One-page pharmacist-prepared acquisition and compliance assessment for the lender’s credit committee. (Must be written to the top level of the working directory using exactly the required filename.; Must contain exactly one readable page.; Must make exactly one recommendation on the loan request and end on that decision.; Must assess Pennsylvania pharmacy requirements as of August 15, 2026.; Must not contain patient or prescriber identities.; Must not invent forecasts, valuations, rates, recovery percentages, or mitigants beyond arithmetic derived from the stated figures.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
